decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is close to the core heat-exchange offer and was launched publicly only a year ago, so management attributes any slow uptake to normal market ramp-up and stays committed.

The air cooled condenser extends the firm's air-cooling line and supports its stated efficiency direction, so the visible investment and strategic fit favor persistence despite possible overlap with Product C.

Although it partly duplicates Product B, the condenser was announced on the website and built with sunk engineering effort, so management is inclined to justify it as serving a distinct application rather than withdraw it.
The tube liner for corroded heat exchangers strengthens the lifecycle service business the firm emphasizes, and early results can easily be read as temporary, so it stays.

The customized air cooler line has several models and embodies the firm's promise of customized integrated solutions, so the heavy investment and central strategic role make dropping it very unlikely.
The tube end repair inserts are a low-cost repair product that complements the service portfolio and supports lifecycle commitments to customers, so management keeps it.
